quote: Our first step is the introduction of a novel set of metrics to evaluate the naturalness of LLM outputs at a corpus level by comparing the lexical and syntactic distributions of LLM outputs with human written texts.

We propose to measure the lexical naturalness of an LLM by comparing the vocabulary distribution of its generated text with that of human-written text... using the Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD). For syntactic naturalness we compute the Weisfeiler‑Lehman graph kernel similarity between dependency trees and then apply the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to obtain a syntactic divergence score.
